description: This file defines the Image class for Drupal's media module, implementing a media source plugin for handling local image files. It includes methods for retrieving image metadata, creating source fields, and preparing view display settings.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A Drupal media source plugin class for handling local image files, providing metadata extraction, source field creation, and display configuration.

methods.name: getMetadataAttributes
methods.description: Returns metadata attributes for image width and height.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves specific metadata (width, height, thumbnail URI, alt text) for a media entity.

methods.name: createSourceField
methods.description: Creates and resets the source field for the media type.

methods.name: prepareViewDisplay
methods.description: Configures the display settings for the image, including image style and link behavior.
